_comment: Indexable-by-default pages that are deliberately noindex, follow and left out of the sitemap. Added 24 Sep 2026 from the content audit (freeze exception #3): sales pages for single blueprints and an affiliate-led calculator, none with search demand. They still return 200. astro.config.mjs reads this for the sitemap filter; each page reads it for its robots meta; content-quality-guard.mjs fails the build if a sitemap URL carries noindex. 9 Nov 2026: fifteen general guides that restate vendor documentation added, so Google judges the site on the pages carrying original work (tools, blueprints, the pricing index, guides with search or citation demand). Reversible: remove a route here to return it to the sitemap. `held` lists those fifteen: they stay linked from other pages and count as live pages for redirect and data checks. Base.astro applies `routes` to every page, so a page needs no prop of its own. 11 Nov 2026: the reliable-automations guide returned to the index with screenshots from the owner's Make account.
